official.name: Estonian
official.family: Finnic / Uralic — unrelated to Lithuanian/Latvian, closer to Finnish

terrainDescription.zh: 平坦地形，多湖泊沼澤，波羅的海沿岸
terrainDescription.en: Flat terrain with many lakes/wetlands, along the Baltic Sea coast

plate.color: white background, black text, standard EU blue band with "EST" code

roadInfra.bollardStyle: Cylindrical bollard, rectangular reflector on the front and two circular reflectors on the back

utilityPole.transformerMount: Distinctive cross-shaped ("crucifix") concrete pole silhouette, unlike neighboring Lithuania/Latvia; occasional wood poles too

historicalContext.zh: 雖同屬「波羅的海三國」地理概念，愛沙尼亞語言系屬其實與立陶宛、拉脫維亞完全不同，是常見的地理迷思。
historicalContext.en: Despite being grouped geographically as one of the "Baltic states," Estonian is linguistically unrelated to Lithuanian/Latvian — a common misconception worth correcting.
